expect.query: UN!PRO 師大夜市 台北

notes: Target is the large red horizontal storefront fascia: read the square Japanese logo top row ユニ, then bottom row プロ, followed by UN!PRO. This is the photographed spelling, not UNIQLO. The partially cropped upper projecting sign, repeated interior branding, sale poster, small address plate, and neighboring shop signs are distractors and omitted. Passersby at lower right are incidental, not the subject. Source description explicitly identifies Taipei Shida Night Market; Japanese lettering does not establish Japan. Historical shop existence and map coverage are unverified.

expect.query: 世界豆漿大王 台北

notes: Target is the large yellow-and-red business sign at upper right. Transcription follows visible left-to-right blocks: 豆漿, the circular 世界 logo (世 above 界), then 大王; the photographer titles the business 世界豆漿大王, used in the search query without reordering the image transcription. Awning-maker details, menus, notices, and the small address plate by the door are not target text and are omitted. Customers and scooters are incidental. Source description explicitly says Taiwan 台北. Exact street address and map match remain unverified.
